caption:
Ever feel worth less than the things around you? Heaven counts you differently. (Amos 2:6 devotional)

The world may price a person below an object; to God, no one is that cheap. Even if no one notices you, God knows your name.

📌 Save this for your quiet time
💬 Where have I been treated as cheap — or quietly treated someone else that way?
